CommonMark 0.31.2: complete official example corpus, unchanged.

GFM 0.29: every extension example extracted unchanged from the published specification.
https://github.github.com/gfm/
https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180/test/spec.txt
